overall: Implemented live boss direction and starter aim/range/terrain feedback in both actual views. Technical validation PASS; historical timeout reproduced; four current exact-layout controller samples cleared. Read-only guidance did not drive the bot and cannot be credited with changing outcomes. No mobile, final economy or universal boss balance approval.

implementation.ownership: boss_guidance.gd reads the existing live RunState. No new gameplay state, save fields, RNG, nodes, timers, inputs or artwork.
implementation.target: Actual starting weapon profile and WeaponModules.target; existing pacing1 boss-priority inclusive reach behavior, old nearest-target pacing and legacy compatibility. Live boss ID/HP/position only. Aimed describes target selection, not guaranteed hits through moving/intervening actors or future terrain.
implementation.terrain: Existing MapSpace.wall_fraction using actual projectile profile width. Center-line terrain obstruction, not a route planner or prediction of every evolving projectile.
implementation.display: Below actual HP bar: approach needed/out of range, terrain blocked/detour, other target, boss aimed. Foreground foot ring for a visible boss; bounded labeled arrow for an offscreen boss, based on actual rendered camera/projection and never the larger spawn guard.
implementation.layout: Status at battle x33%,y26,max360/40%width,height22. Small font11 else13. Marker candidate perimeter reserves mission/HP/radar/player and existing actual pack/shot cue boxes; font-label planner reserves status and marker rectangles. Marker is presentation only, not an attack radius.
implementation.pause: Only RUNNING campaign with a real living boss produces guidance; none before spawn, gold dungeon, pause, choosing or terminal state. No replay clock or saved transient direction.
implementation.unchanged: All62protected files match base: entire tracked gameplay rules/progression/world/data/assets/scenes plus existing other UI/actor helpers. CombatHP/defense/penetration/XP/gold,6min/3min,save15/7RNG,camera8%/fixed1.16spawn guard,old approach warnings,attack4/passive4/MP40/mission retained.
implementation.art: ART001 remains approved master. All53presentation paths empty,GEN005 unapproved and unbound,3D held,support2+2empty. No paid generation.

static_integrity.scope: UTF-8, delimiters, whitespace, JSON/Python syntax, resource existence, project settings; NOT GDScript parser/typechecking or gameplay.

growth_data_contract.scope: JSON schema/content and source integration markers only; not GDScript runtime/behavior.

magic_data_contract.scope: JSON validation, negative data controls and source markers/arithmetic; NOT GDScript runtime, UI, input dispatch or mobile tests.

feedback_source_contract.scope: 7 affected code/test/checker files: UTF-8, delimiters, whitespace, Python syntax, reaction constants, integration markers, engine-test registration and new dependency paths only. NOT the full project check or GDScript parser/type/runtime, rendering, or mobile input tests.

mobile_hud_source_contract.scope: Changed UTF-8 files, delimiters, Python syntax and integration source checks only. NOT GDScript parsing/typechecking, actual Control geometry, touch dispatch, rendering or mobile execution.

run_navigation_source_contract.scope: UTF-8/delimiters/Python syntax and navigation SOURCE contracts only; NOT GDScript parsing/types, native execution, actual UI/input, or mobile testing.

combat_cues_source_contract.scope: Changed-source UTF-8/delimiters/Python syntax, hook order, bounds, isolation, reviewed GAME-024 RunState/GAME-028 view baselines and preserved engine runner. NOT Godot parser/type/runtime, visual quality, input dispatch, or FPS.

godot_runtime.scope: headless import, actual foundation/growth/magic/feedback/mobile-HUD/run-navigation/combat-cues GDScript tests and main boot; visual/mobile approval separate

render.scope: Actual X11/Input.parse_input_event; injected boss geometry/status screenshots; not physical mobile or human completion.

restores.scope: Original1-13 +14campaign/dungeon +15campaign/dungeon +newUI15campaign.14/15/current follow100frames/5sec. Only existing reconstruction/navigation/ticket fields normalized. No source save/schema changes.

campaign.controller: Inherits unchanged GAME022 evolve skill choices,9candidate movement and XP-first movement_goal; does not use new guidance to move or cast. Full18talents. .05step, real6min elapsed and original clear/timeout. No enemy HP/rate/loot/XP gifts.
campaign.layout: HudLayout.build uses window1280x720/no horizontal inset;853x384/28px inset;1600x720/28px inset. All safe areas starty6 andheightwindow-18. Exact resulting battle extent feeds existing Camera.guard_size1.16. Historical case leaves original RunState default untouched. raw.scope: Original unchanged evolve controller; full talents; actual7200steps per6min maximum. No tracking-driven bot or numeric balance changes. Historical RunState default versus current projected1.16spawn guard.

campaign.interpretation: Historical prologue/full/407 reproduces timeout1380HP,438.406distance.60one-second samples show50out of range and9terrain blocked (can overlap). Existing bot prioritizes nearby XP rather than boss tracking. Current exact-layout407standard/compact/wide andseed7standard all clear with11-12choices and2Lv5. Spawn envelope already changed before this UI task; this is not a matched proof that the new guidance improved clear rate or that historical difficulty is resolved. No actual core defect was established by these samples.

committed_source_rerun.note: Re-executed the committed tabs-normalized QA source after code22746e8;all raw rows identical. No production source changes followed.

performance.scope: No new360slime FPS claim. Prior GAME028 software-desktop measurements stay historical. No physical mobile FPS/thermal/DP/touch/notch/WindowsF5/export/human readability approval.

limits: Four current campaign controller samples,all full talents,are limited evidence;old viewport timeout remains reproducible.
Direction/aim/range are current observations;intervening enemies,bullet motion,terrain and other skills can alter actual hits.
Offscreen arrow is a UI aid,not movement automation or pathfinding.
Physical Android/iOS,human readability,final art/audio/export/final economy and old full balance matrices remain unverified.
next: GAME030 actual damage direction and contact-attacker feedback,using committed HP loss and existing reaction/actor/view;no invented attacker or new damage rules.
